maria: Heads-up: minimal SSR sample breaks after Vite production build when importing @redwood-inference/js-sdk. Runtime error: "ReferenceError: exports is not defined" in the SDK file.

jonathan: only in built SSR output or dev server too?

maria: only on build -- ssr optimized output. Dev server is fine. Repro steps:
1) clone private sample repo
2) yarn install
3) VITE_SDK_TARGET=edge yarn build:ssr
4) node --experimental-modules ./dist/server/entry.mjs -> crash

li: can you share package.json deps + vite config? suspect rollup plugin transform ordering.

maria: relevant deps: @redwood-inference/js-sdk@^0.12.0, vite 4.2.1, vite-plugin-scope-hoist 0.3.0, @rollup/plugin-commonjs 21.0.1. vite.config uses scope-hoist in rollupOptions.plugins for ssr build.

sam: scope-hoist can remove CJS wrapper assumptions; if SDK bundle still contains cjs-style `exports` helpers it will break in ESM output. Quick workaround: disable scope-hoist on server build or set commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules=true.

li: long-term: SDK should publish explicit exports map (import -> ESM dist, require -> CJS dist) so bundlers pick correct entry. Also add CI build that runs a Vite SSR build with scope-hoist to catch regressions.

jonathan: opening ticket SDK-2457, assigning to @sam for RFC on export maps + small CI test. maria: please attach your tiny repro repo to the ticket.

ci-bot: sampleapp/vite-scopehoist-repro CI: 1 failed, 3 passed. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/6421 (private).

maria: noted. Posting workaround in devex docs and marking as high priority since hit customer Dedicated deployment.

sam: will draft RFC and a patch release plan.

maria: thanks team, closing this Slack thread and updating ticket with logs and repo link.
